title: MUSE — The language of a face
identity: One original adult brunette woman, modeled consistently across all views and expressions.

studies.title: A quiet joy
studies.prompt: Use the two supplied front/profile portrait references as the primary appearance guide. Create an original adult brunette woman as a native Three.js portrait, with a softly tapered oval face, rounded chin, refined nasal bridge and alae, volumetric rose lips, structured ears and a natural neck. Keep the eyes proportional to the face, with hazel irises, attached eyelid rims, curved lashes and natural brows. Give the swept brunette hair a continuous silhouette, gathered low bun, coherent fine strands and a few face-framing tendrils. Use warm skin with restrained regional color variation and microtexture, soft studio reflections, refined highlights and a green crewneck. Keep the same identity across every expression. Animate exactly five seconds: neutral, preparation, a readable expression, a short hold, recovery and the identical neutral endpoint. Coordinate brow, eyelid, cheek, lip and jaw geometry. Preserve clean occlusion, anatomical attachments and clean silhouettes from front, three-quarter and profile views. Provide selectable facial features, source-backed explanatory labels, a seekable timeline and a guided camera that yields immediately to manual orbit. Raise the mouth corners into a quiet smile. Lift the cheeks and soften the lower eyelids together; keep the upper lip and chin volumes coherent. Let the face settle gently back to neutral.

beats.label: Presence
beats.description: A quiet neutral portrait establishes the same identity across every expression.

beats.label: Gather
beats.description: The first changes begin around the eyes and mouth, with the surrounding face following.

beats.label: Smile
beats.description: The mouth corners lift and widen while the cheeks rise into the lower lids.

beats.label: Release
beats.description: The features recover together without changing the identity or resetting abruptly.

beats.label: Rest
beats.description: The original neutral pose returns and holds through the matching five-second endpoint.

parts.name: Brow & forehead
parts.description: The brows rise, lower and change their medial angle. These surface gestures suggest the action of the forehead and brow region; they are authored expression poses.

parts.name: Eyelids & gaze
parts.description: Upper and lower lid margins change the visible aperture around the eyes. A closed lid covers the iris; the eyeball itself does not shrink.

parts.name: Cheek region
parts.description: The cheeks rise toward the lower lids in a smile and join the upper lip in a nose-wrinkle gesture. The portrait shows surface motion, not isolated internal muscles.

parts.name: Lips & mouth corners
parts.description: The corners lift, lower, stretch or draw inward. Lip contours remain attached to the surrounding face as the opening changes.

parts.name: Jaw & chin
parts.description: An authored jaw release lowers the chin and lower lip together. The lower face returns to the same neutral geometry at the end of the five-second cycle.
